snippet.title: Torch of Shadows Demo - Trailer
snippet.description:
Balance is not optional. It is survival.

The Torch of Shadows demo has been completely reworked.

New systems. Sharper combat. Stronger progression. Harder decisions.

You are the last guardian of an ancient universe collapsing under the clash of Light and Darkness.
Use Light against Dark. Use Dark against Light.
Counter wrong… and you waste time.
In hard mode, you might even heal them.

⚔ Dual-form reactive combat
🗺 10 handcrafted corrupted realms
👑 10 unique bosses
🧩 50+ Pylon minigames
🌀 20+ Soul cleansing challenges
🔁 Roguelite progression with escalating chaos

Reclaim shattered regions.
Restore the altar.
Prevent the Void.

The updated demo is now live on Steam. https://store.steampowered.com/app/4007420/Torch_of_Shadows/

Steam Next Fest starts soon.
We are ready.

Wishlist Torch of Shadows and experience the balance yourself.
